description: Use this when the user wants to change a setting on one of their funds. Starts a change to the settings they name. Returns Capital Company’s next question, or the proposed change for the user to confirm. This call changes nothing.

request.description: What the user asked for, in their own words

team.description: The team to act on, by name, only when the user belongs to more than one team; leave it out otherwise

timeZone.description: The user’s IANA time zone, such as America/New_York

name: capital_company_update_fund
title: Update a fund’s settings
